{{Quote|Visions of my father ripped to shreds by&hellip; Sand People, and Master Farlonn preaches temperance! I cannot stay, cannot complete my training!|Farlonn's Padawan|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Farlonn''' was a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] whose [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] lost her father to the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Farlonn's [[Farlonn's Padawan|apprentice]] fled her training and headed to Tatooine to avenge her father, but succumbed to [[sand fever]].
